neighbours.label: a word-final piece as its own token after a capitalised consonant start: 'ell' in Sm|ell, 'ift' in Dr|ift, 'ipe' in W|ipe, 'ells' in Sm|ells (not the whole-token lowercase words)
fire: Taste and Smell are closely linked senses.
Remove the Smell of smoke from old curtains.

Continental Drift was proposed by Alfred Wegener.
Snow Drift warnings were issued for the pass.
Step two: Wipe the counter with a damp cloth.
Vacuum the seats, then Wipe down the doors.

quiet: Taste and smell are closely linked senses.
Remove the Stain of smoke from old curtains.
The Journal of Taste and Touch published the study.
Continental Shift was a phrase used in the lecture.
Snow Storm warnings were issued for the pass.
Step two: Swipe the card through the reader.
Vacuum the seats, then Spell out the name on the form.

notes: Card: 'ell' x7 (all 'Sm|ell'), 'ach', 'ift', 'ipe', 'its', 'els'. Tokenizer: ' Smell' -> ' Sm'+'ell', ' Drift' -> ' Dr'+'ift', ' Wipe' -> ' W'+'ipe'; lowercase ' smell' and ' Spell', ' Swipe', ' Shift' are single tokens. Probes: Sm|ell 0.88, Dr|ift 0.77, W|ipe 0.47, Sm|ells 0.38, but Qu|ell 0.21, Thr|ift 0.16, Ro|ach 0.14, Sw|ell 0.11, so the preceding piece matters. A list of piece pairs; coverage is probably low.
